entries.title: Psalms 8:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker on the Gittith. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, our Lord, whose glory is higher than the heavens, how noble is your name in all the earth!

entries.title: Psalms 8:2
segments: You have made clear your strength even out of the mouths of babies at the breast, because of those who are against you; so that you may put to shame the cruel and violent man.

entries.title: Psalms 8:3
segments: ¶When I see your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have put in their places;

entries.title: Psalms 8:4
segments: What is man, that you keep him in mind? the son of man, that you take him into account?

entries.title: Psalms 8:5
segments: For you have made him only a little lower than the gods, crowning him with glory and honour.

entries.title: Psalms 8:6
segments: You have made him ruler over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet;

entries.title: Psalms 8:7
segments: All sheep and oxen, and all the beasts of the field;

entries.title: Psalms 8:8
segments: The birds of the air and the fish of the sea, and whatever goes through the deep waters of the seas.

entries.title: Psalms 8:9
segments: O Lord, our Lord, how noble is your name in all the earth!
